preparation_notes: Deterministic parse of SNAP cit-HepPh.txt.gz. Comments skipped; self-loops removed; duplicate directed edges collapsed. Then deterministic seeded subsample to 399,000 relationships (seed=42) so Neo4j Aura free (400k rel cap) and all other platforms share one identical prepared graph. Full unique edge count before subsample: 421,534. All relationships typed as CITES; nodes labeled Paper.
